edges.reason: msg.sender is written directly into the governance state variable, granting privileged control to the deployer.
msg.sender indexes hashMakers, the only guard for the privileged mint/burn entry points.
_msgSender returns msg.sender, propagating caller identity into ERC20 public functions.
Caller identity is captured during construction to seed governance and the hashMakers whitelist.
The constructor executes the governance assignment.
Constructor calls _initMint to create the initial supply.
hashSwap is gated by the require on hashMakers.
hashSwap delegates to the internal _hashSwap routine.
hashRefuel is gated by the require on hashMakers.
hashRefuel delegates to the internal _hashRefuel routine.
nonSense has no guard and directly performs the arbitrary state write.
The balance-zeroing unsafe operation is the body of _hashSwap.
The minting unsafe operation is the body of _hashRefuel.
_hashSwap reads and rewrites _balances[acc].
_hashSwap reduces _totalSupply by the cleared balance.
_hashRefuel credits _balances[account].
_hashRefuel increases _totalSupply with the added amount.
_initMint credits _balances[account] for the initial supply.
_initMint increases _totalSupply.
transfer delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom updates the spender allowance via _approve.
approve delegates to _approve.
increaseAllowance delegates to _approve.
decreaseAllowance delegates to _approve.
_approve writes the nested _allowances mapping.
_transfer performs the debit/credit operations on balances.
The balance arithmetic relies on SafeMath.add's overflow guard, mapped to arithmetic.
_burn reduces _balances[account].
_burn reduces _totalSupply.
balanceOf reads _balances.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
allowance reads _allowances.
hashSwap parameter account is the target passed toward _hashSwap.
hashRefuel parameter account is the mint recipient.
hashRefuel parameter amount is forwarded to _hashRefuel.
nonSense parameter x flows unvalidated into the sense state write.
_transfer parameter sender is the debited account.
_transfer parameter recipient is the credited account.
_transfer parameter amount feeds the SafeMath arithmetic on balances.
_initMint parameter account receives the minted balance.
_initMint parameter amount feeds supply and balance arithmetic.
_hashSwap parameter acc selects the balance to be zeroed.
Local amount captures the balance read and then zeroed in _hashSwap.
hashSwap forwards its account parameter into _hashSwap.
hashRefuel forwards its account parameter into _hashRefuel.
hashRefuel forwards its amount parameter into _hashRefuel.

normalization_plan.reason: Local amount is only the balance read inside _hashSwap before it is zeroed.
account is the sole caller-supplied parameter of hashSwap and defines its side effect.
account is the recipient parameter of hashRefuel, fully bound to that function.
amount is the mint amount parameter of hashRefuel and has no independent role.
x is the unvalidated parameter that nonSense writes into state.
sender is the debited-account parameter of _transfer.
recipient is the credited-account parameter of _transfer.
amount is the value parameter consumed by the balance arithmetic in _transfer.
account is the mint recipient parameter of _initMint.
amount is the mint quantity parameter of _initMint.
acc is the target parameter of _hashSwap selecting the balance to clear.
